description:
Do you believe in the fate of the Fontana di Trevi fountain? Ryu Hwan fell in love at first sight with Soo-yeon, whom he met in Venice after being discharged from the army to find his younger sister. "You will be my country."

Ryu Hwan, who fell in love, didn't want to lose Soo-yeon, whom he met as fate. But did she think otherwise? During a trip to Rome together, Sooyeon returns to Japan without saying a word. Min Suyeon is the only child of Cho Chongryun and Song Ryuhwan, the daughter of a country's president. 

A story of two people looking for love 'in spite of everything'.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=787314), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8014008)
